title: MRAgent — paper view
subtitle: The mechanism as Ji et al. describe it (Algorithm 1 + Appendix B.1). Lane = canonical stage (METHODOLOGY-SKELETON §2.2); empty lanes mean the paper defines no such step.
source: Ji et al. 2026, MRAgent (arXiv:2606.06036v1, ICML 2026 / PMLR 306)   ·   verified against servers/mragent/verification.md §3 (60 paper-side assertions: 47 ✓ / 1 ✗ / 11 ◐ / 1 ?)
legend_notes: A3 ADMIT and B5 SELECT are both empty: the paper never describes a write-time dedup/admission step, and retrieval settles for whatever f_route keeps — no combinatorial selection or quota.

B8 LOOP is one of only 4/14 systems that fill this lane. f_select and STOP/C_LLM are Algorithm 1's real loop; it cycles within B3 (traversal) -> B4 (f_route) -> B8 (stop check) and back to B8 (f_select), not all the way back to B1/B2.

The A5 Store:Graph node is an interpretive call, not a literal quote: §7 explicitly disclaims that construction 'does not update or consolidate memory over time', but the graph M is still the addressable object queried at retrieval time — see summary for the alternative reading.
